newsitem.title: UK: Wickes says rights issue likely this week.
newsitem.headline: Wickes says rights issue likely this week.

text.p: Do-it-yourself retailer Wickes Plc, whose former senior managers are under investigation by the Serious Fraud Office, said on Sunday it was likely to launch its rights issue this week.
"We have not given an exact date for the rights issue but it is likely to be this week," a spokesman told Reuters.
He said the company had not given any details on the size of the rights issue which press reports have put at 50 million stg.
Some analysts believe the rights issue could trigger a takeover bid. The spokesman said Wickes would carry on putting its new business plan, which includes the rights issue, into operation.
